title: chrysanthemum zawadzkii subsp. peleiolepis
intro: Chrysanthemum zawadzkii subsp. peleiolepis, commonly known as Korean chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family that is native to Korea and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve sleep, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Korean chrysanthemum include promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety and depression, and relieving symptoms of menopausal hot flashes. The bioactive constituents of Korean chrysanthemum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies.
